project_name.justification: The primary project is identified in the title of the press release: 'Aston Bay Signs LOI to Option Epworth Sediment Hosted Copper-Silver-Zinc-Cobalt Project, Nunavut, Canada'.

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified as 'Aston Bay Holdings Ltd. (TSX-V:BAY)(OTCQB:ATBHF)(the "Company" or "Aston Bay")'.

ceo_buyer.justification: A quote in the article identifies the CEO of the acquiring company: '"We are very excited to option the Epworth Property," stated Thomas Ullrich, CEO of Aston Bay.'

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The agreement grants Aston Bay an option 'to acquire an undivided 80% beneficial interest in a property owned by EGS in Nunavut, Canada (the "Property").'

primary_commodity.justification: The project is described as the 'Epworth Sediment Hosted Copper-Silver-Zinc-Cobalt Project', with Copper listed first. The text also refers to it as a 'high-grade copper project'.

verified_article_link.justification: The article is directly about the transaction for the Epworth project, as stated in its title: 'Aston Bay Signs LOI to Option Epworth Sediment Hosted Copper-Silver-Zinc-Cobalt Project, Nunavut, Canada'.

currency.justification: The transaction involves payments in dollars ('$'). The acquiring company, Aston Bay Holdings Ltd., is listed on the Canadian TSX Venture Exchange ('TSX-V:BAY'), which implies the currency is Canadian Dollars (CAD).

cash_payments_raw.justification: The terms of the agreement state: 'Aston Bay also agreed to make a cash payment of $50,000 to EGS on the business day following the date of the Agreement.'

share_payments_raw.justification: The transaction terms do not mention any payment in shares.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: An explicit cash payment is mentioned, so this field is not applicable according to the extraction hierarchy.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: No shares were issued as part of the transaction consideration.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No share warrants are mentioned in the transaction terms.

option_payments_raw.justification: The transaction is an option to acquire an interest in the property, but no stock options were issued as payment.

issued_share_price.justification: No shares were issued as part of the transaction, so there is no issue price.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The exploration commitment is defined as a monetary value, not a drilling meterage.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: Under the terms of the Agreement, Aston Bay can earn an 80% undivided interest in the Property by spending a minimum of $3 million on qualifying exploration expenditures ('Expenditures') over a four-year period.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The agreement includes terms for a 2% net smelter return royalty to be retained by the seller (EGS) if their interest is diluted below 10%: 'its interest will be converted into a 2% net smelter return if its interest is diluted to below 10%'.

coverage_area_raw.justification: At the time of the agreement, the property was described as consisting of '51 claims covering an area of 71,134.86 hectares (175,778 acres)'.

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the coverage area is explicitly stated: '71,134.86 hectares'.

resource_size.justification: The text provides grades from grab samples and drill intercepts (e.g., '10.4% Cu over 0.9m'), but does not contain a quantified mineral resource statement with mass or volume units like tonnes or ounces.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The press release identifies the acquiring company and its ticker as 'Aston Bay Holdings Ltd. (TSX-V:BAY)(OTCQB:ATBHF)'.
